# 2 bed terraced house for sale

> iMOVE are delighted to present 18 Bargy Road to the Dublin 3 property market. This attractive mid-terrace residence is presented in excellent condition and will appeal to both owner-occupiers and investors alike. The accommodation at ground floor level comprises of a welcoming entrance hall, a bright living room, large kitchen, and a spacious downstairs bathroom.
